evidence.Default/Left/Right: pdf3 (printed 5): Control Button (leader to the cross pad) - Use this Control Button to maneuver the Warp Rattler.
evidence.Default/Up/Down: pdf3 (printed 5): Control Button (leader to the cross pad) - Use this Control Button to maneuver the Warp Rattler.
evidence.Default/A: pdf3 (printed 5): Button A (trigger) (leader to the right round button) - Use this to fire the Warp Rattler's sophisticated on-board armament.
evidence.Default/B: pdf3 (printed 5): Button B (power booster) (leader to the left round button) - Use for power boosts. (Hit this button when you are in position to make a power boost.); pdf4 (printed 6): When a desired indicator lights up, hit the power boost button (Button B) to activate that power boost.
evidence.Default/Start: pdf3 (printed 5): Start Button - Use this button to start the game after you have selected the number of players. (Pause function: During play, this button also acts as a toggle switch to stop and resume the game.)
evidence.Default/Select: pdf3 (printed 5): Selector Button - When the Konami Title comes on your screen, use this button to move the Warp Rattler image and make your selection of one player or two players. (only documented use)
